name: Boucles Fannia
ligne: Quatre pierres taille poire réunies par la pointe et ouvertes en éventail, tenues par des griffes.
description: Boucles Fannia, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, ou bicolore, serties chacune de diamants taille poire. Aussi proposées en émeraudes, rubis ou saphirs.
details: Or blanc 750 ‰, Or jaune 750 ‰, Or rose 750 ‰, Or rose et blanc
Serties chacune de diamants taille poire

en.ligne: Four pear-shaped stones, joined at the point and opening into a fan, held in claws.
en.description: Fannia earrings in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, or two-tone, each set with pear-shaped diamonds. Also available in emeralds, rubies or sapphires.

it.ligne: Quattro pietre taglio a goccia unite per la punta e aperte a ventaglio, montate a griffe.
it.description: Orecchini Fannia in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, o bicolore, ciascuno con diamanti taglio a goccia. Disponibili anche con smeraldi, rubini o zaffiri.
